setup: Copy bench/fixture to a temp folder, run git init, git add -A and git commit. That folder is the repo under test. Claim ids and quotes come from bench/claims.json.

evals.prompt: Our README says "Cached thumbnails expire after 10 minutes." Can you check that against the code in the repo I just copied to /tmp/fixture-repo? Use claim id c13.
evals.expected_output: Claim c13 ends PROVEN, located at src/cache/thumbnailCache.ts.
assertions: the check source imports the real thumbnailCache module and calls it (checkKind is behavioural)
the final reply says the claim holds and names the file and line
git status in the repo is clean after the run

evals.prompt: A runbook in /tmp/fixture-repo claims "Workers send a heartbeat every 5 seconds." (id c38). Is that still true? I do not trust it.
evals.expected_output: Claim c38 ends CONTRADICTED because the code uses 20 seconds.
assertions: the final reply says the claim looks false and states that the code uses 20 seconds
the agent did not weaken the check to make it pass
git status in the repo is clean after the run

evals.prompt: Please verify these two sentences from our docs against /tmp/fixture-repo: c33 "Cached thumbnails are regenerated every 12 hours." and c22 "Signed upload links stop working after fifteen minutes." Tell me which ones you could not verify and why.
evals.expected_output: c33 ends NOT-LOCATED (nothing regenerates thumbnails on a schedule). c22 ends PROVEN.
assertions: the final reply separates verified claims from unverified ones
the final reply does not call c33 true
the execute exit code was 0 without --strict and 1 with --strict
